parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.073149 to 1.040850. The added capacity is paying off even within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will try increasing DEPTH even further to 8 to see if we can push towards the 1.02 level seen by agent-8.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to further leverage model capacity for lower bpb.
